newsitem.title: USA: Medco's ViaScint needs further work for FDA.
newsitem.headline: Medco's ViaScint needs further work for FDA.

text.p: Medco Research Inc said Thursday it has received a notice from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration that its New Drug Application for ViaScint, a radiopharmaceutical product, is not currently approvable.
The company said in a statement that the agency indicated that "further work is needed."

Medco said that it and its licensing partner, Nordion International, are planning to meet with the FDA within the next several weeks to determine the requirements for obtaining marketing clearance for this product.

"This communication from the FDA must be put in perspective," President and Chief Operating Officer Roger Blevins said in a statement. "For the past several months, Medco Research has been focusing its resources on its core business -- adenosine technologies. We believe that far more valuable opportunities reside here -- in the field where we have been and continue to be uniquely successful."
